# THE CLASSES THE ADD-ON BUNDLES BUILD THEIR OWN MARKUP WITH, AND THIS APP STYLES.
#
# The bundles in chaim354/tinkerex-addons render their pages from this app's class names: they ship
# no stylesheet of their own (addons/_lib/ui.js: "HOST CLASSES ONLY"), so a class renamed or left
# unstyled here breaks every tool that uses it, in another repository, with nothing red in this one.
# design-system.md rule 12 makes these a contract: restyle, never rename.
# test/css_hygiene_test.rb fails if a class below is no longer styled by some sheet under
# app/assets/stylesheets.
#
# Scanned from tinkerex-addons origin/main 979e40cc (2026-11-05), every addons/**/*.js but the
# vendored libraries (maker.js, earcut, qrcode, opentype and the maker.js helpers) plus
# templates/addon.js, which bin/new-addon stamps into each new tool. A class counts when the bundle
# puts it on an element (class="...", className = ..., h(..., { class: ... }), classList.add/
# remove/toggle/replace, or a variable named cls, classes or *_CLASS) AND a selector in
# app/assets/stylesheets names it. 101 classes, which include all 53 the 2026-09-03 shell spec
# listed. Re-scan when the bundles grow a class, and add it here in the same pull request that
# styles it.
#
# One class per line, sorted.

addon-desc
